NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 8, 12:37 PM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 22.1 DraftKings points for $8,800, at Washington. CeeDee Lamb (21.8, $8,300) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (20.6, $9,300) are next.

Ryan Flournoy returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.84 projected points per $1,000 at $4,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 8, 12:37 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 9

Puka Nacua, LAR at WAS ($8,800)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.1 DraftKings points at $8,800, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.3 points clear of CeeDee Lamb. The model gives him 10.8 targets on 30.8 routes. The salary works out to 2.52 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 32 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Nacua averaged 22.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.8 and a ceiling of 48.7, and he holds 23% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Washington, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL at IND ($8,300)

CeeDee Lamb projects 2nd at the position with 21.8 DraftKings points at $8,300. The model gives him 11.3 targets on 32.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.63 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 32 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Lamb averaged 21.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 46.4, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA vs ARI ($9,300)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects 3rd at the position with 20.6 DraftKings points at $9,300. The model gives him 9.3 targets on 26.5 routes. The salary works out to 2.22 projected points per $1,000, 11th of 32 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.1 and a ceiling of 45.1, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 39.5.

Value: Ryan Flournoy, DAL at IND ($4,800)

Ryan Flournoy projects for 13.6 DraftKings points at $4,800, which works out to 2.84 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 32 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 6.6 targets on 29.0 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Flournoy averaged 13.7 points with a simulated floor of 1.4 and a ceiling of 41.1, and he holds 20% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 51.5.
